Welcome to EMF 2026!
Welcome aboard PhotoSYNTH Mission Control!

This is FACES IN SPACE...
A smile-powered space synthesizer =D

Your face is the flight controller
Your expressions launch the sounds

Smile or open your mouth
To begin the countdown!

Pose like an emoji
To discover new instruments

Tilt your head
To steer through the notes

Roll your head
Like a satellite in orbit

Every player is
a tiny musical spacecraft

Make eye contact with the camera
Then send us a signal from your face

Big smiles
Make bright major sounds

Moon faces
Make the night glow

Surprised faces
Open the airlock

Kisses become comets
With glowing tails

Alien faces may contact
Another galaxy

The Sun's light takes about 8 minutes
To reach Earth

Your smile arrives
Much faster

The Moon moves away by about 3.8 cm each year
So make your Moon face before it escapes

Mars has the tallest volcano
In the Solar System

Open your mouth
Like you just saw it

Comets are ancient icy leftovers
Blow a comet kiss across the screen

If you hear a new sound...
You probably discovered a new expression

Play with friends
For cosmic harmony

More faces means
More strange space music

Keep exploring
Until mission complete

Scan the QR code
To continue at home

Or visit photosynth.app
Mission Control believes in you!
